title: Knotrail Cave-In
text: Raiders have folded a transit rail into a barbed knot. On failure, suffer 1 Wound and fix this Hazard to the sector. Operatives may enter the blocked sector, but no movement route may cross through it until the Cave-In is cleared.
flavor: A road can be held hostage without a guard.

successEffect.text: You cut the knotted rail apart and reopened the through-route.
